ruleDefinitions.name: Active Directory Kerberos DLL Loaded Via Office Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Kerberos DLL being loaded by an Office Product Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mspub\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenote\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\onenoteim\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\kerberos\\\.dll$"))
